display.title: Episode 271: The Mystery of Dayeinu (Rosh Chodesh Nissan)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Rosh Chodesh Nissan show: the month of miracles, a brand-new song 'Ad Mosai', a Shema guest from Australia, and the story of how 'Dayeinu' at the Seder found the king's lost ring.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Rosh Chodesh Nissan 5747. Uncle Yossi explains the blessings asked for on Shabbos Mevarchim (life, peace, joy and the Geulah) and why Nissan, the month of the Exodus, is named for miracles (nes). It is the right time to call out to Hashem 'Ad Mosai', how long until Moshiach, and he teaches a new five-line song with those words, which then becomes the Hakochainik march. After a sponsor message, a third-grade girl visiting from Sydney, Australia recites the Shema and tells what she is learning. Story time, for the coming Pesach: Reb Sholom, famous for hachnasas orchim, has more Yom Tov guests than he can afford and prays from his Tehillim. The king loses his ring and rewards Reb Sholom's offer to help with a sack of gold. On Seder night the king, listening at the window, hears everyone sing 'Dayeinu' and realizes that is the name of his servant, who indeed has the ring. The show ends with candle-lighting time and a reminder to sell the chametz.
display.lesson: Hashem answers the prayers of those who open their homes to guests; and in Nissan, the month of miracles, we call out 'Ad Mosai' for Moshiach.

date.note: Confirmed in the audio: 'today is Rosh Chodesh Nissan'; Shabbos candles Friday, April 3.
